data.one_liner: Cupertino-style continuous or segmented slider widget
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable slider inspired by Apple Music. It supports gradients, custom icons, segments, and optional callbacks for focus and change events.
use_when: You need a Cupertino-themed slider with minimal setup
You want to customize icons, colors, or add discrete segments
You need a gradient progress bar or animated icon transitions
avoid_when: You require a Material design slider
You need advanced accessibility features not covered by this widget
strengths: Highly customizable with icons, gradients, and segments
Built-in padding and size transition for smooth UI
Supports both continuous and segmented modes
weaknesses: Only Cupertino style, no Material variant
No built-in accessibility support beyond basic Flutter slider
data.minimal_example:
InteractiveSlider(
  startIcon: const Icon(CupertinoIcons.volume_down),
  centerIcon: const Text('Center'),
  endIcon: const Icon(CupertinoIcons.volume_up),
  min: 1.0,
  max: 15.0,
  onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _value = value),
)
